characters.name: Berenger
characters.description: The lazy, alienated, and heavy-drinking protagonist who resists conforming. But he is also strong willed and kind, the only character left human at the end of the play. Appears throughout the whole play.

characters.name: Jean
characters.description: Berenger’s arrogant, rational, and well-dressed friend who eventually transforms into a rhinoceros. Appears in 3 out of 4 scenes. Older than Berenger.

characters.name: Daisy
characters.description: Berenger’s love interest and an office coworker. Appears in 3 out of 4 scenes.

characters.name: Dudard
characters.description: An intellectual office coworker and rival for Daisy's affection. Appears in 2 scenes.

characters.name: Botard
characters.description: A cynical, skeptical senior office worker.

characters.name: Mrs. Bœuf
characters.description: A devoted wife who jumps after her transformed husband.

characters.name: The Logician
characters.description: A pedantic character who strictly trusts abstract logic.

characters.name: Housewife (and her beloved cat)
characters.description: Distraught when her cat is hurt

characters.name: Waiter/ress
characters.description: A sensible, efficient worker even when all around is madness
